text:
Asha Rao: quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem  we listed actions but didn't lock down owners for the runbook edits, escalation matrix, and recurrence tagging. who can take these?
Ben Feldman: I can handle the runbook edits (safe checks + idempotent commands). target: Thu EOD.
Ivy Wu: I'll update the escalation matrix and paging steps, and attach a small diagram. target: next Tue.
Carlos Mendez: I'll add recurrence tagging automation and a saved filter + grafana tile. will also write a short playbook section for recurring incidents. target: Mon.
Asha Rao: perfect. please paste the repo paths so I can add links to the postmortem tracker. also include a tiny eval plan in PRs to check MTTI impact.
Ben Feldman: runbook path: docs/runbooks/ops/safe-ops-latency.md
Ivy Wu: escalation doc: docs/runbooks/escalation/oncall-paging-v2.md (diagram in PR)
Carlos Mendez: recurrence playbook: docs/playbooks/recurrence/recurrence-guidance.md and dashboard: infra/grafana/dashboards/recurrence.json
Ben Feldman: sample safe command snippets I'll add to the runbook: ```
# check model latency (idempotent)
rwinfctl metrics tail --model=chat-main --window=5m | jq '.p95'
# dry-run route change
rwinfctl router set-route --route=chat-main --model=chat-fallback --weight=100 --dry-run
# apply if confirmed
rwinfctl router set-route --route=chat-main --model=chat-fallback --weight=100
```
Ivy Wu: paging suggestion: extend p95 transient window to 8m and add pre-page validation: "confirm spike not due to batch jobs". I'll stage the change and report results.
Carlos Mendez: recurrence tagging plan: add label recurrence=true and recurrence_count integer. I'll create a saved search "recurrence:yes AND created>=-30d" and link it in the playbook.
postmortem-bot: created TASK-4456 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TASK-4456) "Runbook/escalation/recurrence edits" assigned to Ben, Ivy, Carlos. Due dates set as requested.
Asha Rao: thanks. once you open PRs drop links here and include the eval (MTTI before/after). I'll close the postmortem items after merges.
Ben Feldman: will open draft PR today.
Ivy Wu: diagram uploaded and PR incoming.
Carlos Mendez: saved filter and invite for biweekly "recurrence review" sent to SRE + Prod.
Asha Rao: great work, team. :tada:
